name: Software Engineering
tagline: Run a coding agent on a project, review its changes, and decide what to apply.

useCases.title: Implement a feature
useCases.description: Hand an agent a ticket; review the diff, then apply it or open a PR.

useCases.title: Fix a failing build
useCases.description: Point an agent at a failing test and confirm the suite passes.

useCases.title: Review a pull request
useCases.description: Ask an agent to review a PR for bugs and missed edge cases.

useCases.title: Resume a past session
useCases.description: Import a Claude Code or Codex thread and keep working in Ryu.

faq.q: Will an agent edit my working tree directly?
faq.a: Only if you let it. Turn on worktree mode and each run gets its own git worktree and branch; you review the diff, then merge or open a PR.

faq.q: Can I keep using Claude Code or Codex?
faq.a: Yes. Ryu runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other agents behind one interface. Data rules apply to agents routed through Ryu's Gateway, such as Codex; Claude Code and Gemini CLI call their providers directly.
